First off, let me confess: I NEVER play the lottery.

I have zero interest in throwing money away, which is what i think lotteries are.

That said, i HAVE a plan if i won, by a long shot, after hell freezes over:

  1. hire an accountant and at attorney, like the minute you win. Yes, they will get money from you. BUT they are the best defense when all of your new found 'friends' and family sniff you out. Make sure these are people you TRUST.
  2. Those phones you have? DITCH THEM. Get two prepaid phones. One for your immediate family, and one for your lawyer.
  3. Time to hit the road. Rent an RV, buy tickets to the other side of the country, just take a bit of the sum and live it up! This is two fold, because when you travel (i drove across America in two weeks, found great places) you can find places to possibly get a condo or house. You never know what's around the next bend. You need to NOT be home until the dust settles, because people will be looking for you, with their hand out.
  4. The dust settles. gather the family together(uncles, aunts etc.) and have a party. This is the 'one time payment party.' Have a mortgage? Done. Car payments. Done. Of course, this is all in reason, and documentation needs to be provided.
  5. Don't think you have to have EVERYTHING. A car for every day of the week? A million dollar home? Meh. Designer clothes? Spend a bit on yourself, but figure out the interest of the money is, and try to live off that.
  6. Give back. Right now, i give $10 to charity: water every month. I would love to provide a well for one of the villages that need one, but i am on a budget that allows this, as well as canned food giving every time i shop. I would love to see one of charity: water's $10,000 wells be built. I'd love to pay for a year's worth of training for one of the people in need of basic things like food, so they can get a hand up, instead of a hand out. Plus it feels good to give.
  7. Live happily ever after. Get a good doctor, nutritionist/fitness instructor and have fun!

Fun is more important than money, and it you can have fun, you've already won the lottery!
